informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SC-8 (Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity), SC-8(1) (Cryptographic Protection)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 PR.DS-02 (data-in-transit protected)
implementation_examples: Protect data-in-transit using cryptographic protocols commensurate with data sensitivity, applied to inter-service traffic, user-to-service traffic, and data exchange with third parties
Validate certificates and algorithm strength at the receiver
Apply the same protections to third-party data flows
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data-in-transit is protected cryptographically
Determine whether the cryptographic strength is commensurate with sensitivity
Determine whether certificate validation is enforced
Determine whether third-party flows are protected
